The '''CR20 troop carrier''' or '''CR-20 trooper carrier''' was a type of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ship used to deploy small units of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:CR-20_Porax_TCWCG_2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A CR-20 defends itself from a [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class starfighter]].]]
The CR20 troop [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] was armed with two double [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons. It was sixty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and could carry up to forty [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], twelve [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]], and their corresponding supplies. The carrier's crew consisted of two [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], one communications officer, and three engineers.

==History==
Originally designed by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] for use by its security forces, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] purchased surplus CR-20s one standard month after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. Despite this, they were widely unseen in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] early in the Clone Wars.<ref name="The Clone Wars: No Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref> It was not until the [[Battle of JanFathal]], where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] piloted a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]]-owned CR-20 to rescue [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] operative [[Hallena Devis]], that the usefulness of the CR-20 Troop Carrier became evident.<ref name="The Clone Wars: No Prisoners" /> Generally, they were used in situations where the large [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] were impractical or unneeded.
